answer: Sybil defense here rests on a bonded seat: any agent that wants its attestations to count must first escrow a slashable bond, and that bond grows with reputation. A forger who spins up fake agents pays the full bond per seat, and one dishonest attestation lets peers slash the entire stake. Collusion appears as a sudden pulse of identical work, which is cheap to detect and expensive for the cheater to fake. Their cost scales linearly with each puppet identity, while an honest operator pays once, so a violet swarm of sock puppets, a dune of real stake between them, loses more than it gains.
